summary: 150053568350107_1422683599881923 admin July 22, 2026 In recognition of Pride and Indigenous History Month, Cameco was honoured to welcome Dr. James Makokis to Saskatoon. A Cree, Two-Spirit physician from Saddle Lake First Nation and co-winner of The Amazing Race Canada Season 7, Dr. Makokis shared an inspiring and thought-provoking presentation with our employees on creating inclusive spaces for transgender and Two-Spirit people. Thank you, Dr. Makokis, for helping us continue to learn, reflect and build a more inclusive workplace for all.
